entries.title: Isaiah 12:1
segments: ¶And in that day thou shalt say, Jehovah, I will praise thee; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:2
segments: Behold, *God is my salvation: I will trust, and not be afraid; for Jah, Jehovah, is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:3
segments: And with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:4
segments: ¶And in that day shall ye say, Give ye thanks to Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his deeds among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:5
segments: Sing psalms of Jehovah, for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:6
segments: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitress of Zion; for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
